title: Screen the pass into the #9
titleKid: Block the pass to their striker
brief: Their #9 has dropped into the space in front of your centre-backs.
briefKid: Their striker comes into the space in front of your defenders.
question: They have moved the ball across. Which pass do you need to block now?
questionKid: They moved the ball across. Which pass do you block now?

takeaway.standard: As the #6, stay in front of your centre-backs and move with the ball so you are always standing in the passing line into their #9.
takeaway.kid: Stand in the path of the pass to their striker.

misconceptions.text: You stayed where the ball was, so the pass from its new spot into their #9 is wide open.
misconceptions.textKid: The ball moved. Move across to block the pass to their striker.

misconceptions.text: You went to press the ball, but that leaves the space in front of your centre-backs empty for their #9.
misconceptions.textKid: Leave the ball to others. Guard the space in front of your defenders.
